title: Inserting images into slides
text: Google Slides API can embed images reachable via https:// URL — way upload raw binary data directly slide. means local files need two-step detour: Upload file somewhere Google’s servers can fetch . Pass URL (Google Drive file ID) add_create_image_request(). sections cover source order complexity.

title: Inserting images into slides
text: image already hosted publicly accessible web server, pass URL directly:
code: props  <- get_slides_properties("<presentation-id>") page_id <- props$slides[[1]]$objectId  prop <- page_element_property(   page_id,   height_magnitude = 200,   width_magnitude  = 300,   scale_x = 1, scale_y = 1,   translate_x = 100, translate_y = 100,   transform_unit = "PT" )  req <- add_create_image_request(   page_element_property = prop,   url = "https://example.com/logo.png" ) commit_to_slides("<presentation-id>", req)

title: Inserting images into slides
text: image already Google Drive, pass file ID (long alphanumeric string Drive URL) instead https:// URL. rgoogleslides detects value URL constructs authenticated download link automatically: Note: access token embedded query parameter URL sent Slides API. appear API request bodies network logs. sensitive environments prefer publicly accessible https:// URL.
code: req <- add_create_image_request(   page_element_property = prop,   url = "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgVE2upms"  # Drive file ID ) commit_to_slides("<presentation-id>", req)

title: Inserting images into slides
text: Local files must uploaded Google Drive first. googledrive package handles shares credentials rgoogleslides via gargle, extra sign-required. three steps must kept order: Drive cleanup happen commit_to_slides(), Slides API fetches image server-side commit time.
code: # install.packages("googledrive") library(googledrive)  # 1. Upload to Drive tmp <- drive_upload("path/to/my-plot.png", type = "image/png") file_id <- as.character(as_id(tmp))  # 2. Add to the slide and commit req <- add_create_image_request(   page_element_property = prop,   url = file_id ) commit_to_slides("<presentation-id>", req)  # 3. Remove from Drive drive_rm(tmp)

title: Inserting images into slides
text: page_element_property() gives full control position size using translate (top-left corner) scale values. unit can "PT" (points) "EMU" (English Metric Units, used internally API). two common cases — centred full-page — use convenience wrapper aligned_page_element_property(): default slide dimensions assumed aligned_page_element_property() 9 144 000 × 5 143 500 EMU (standard 16:9 widescreen). presentation uses different size, pass slide_page_width slide_page_height explicitly.
code: page_id <- props$slides[[2]]$objectId  # Centre a 300 × 200 pt image on the slide prop_centre <- aligned_page_element_property(   page_id,   image_width  = 300,   image_height = 200,   align = "center" )  # Stretch to fill the entire slide prop_full <- aligned_page_element_property(   page_id,   align = "full" )

title: Inserting images into slides
text: common template workflow insert named shape placeholder slide design, swap image render time. add_replace_all_shapes_with_image_request() finds every shape whose text matches given string replaces : replace_method controls image fitted shape’s bounding box: can restrict replacement specific pages passing character vector page IDs page_object_ids.
code: req <- add_replace_all_shapes_with_image_request(   image_url      = "https://example.com/chart.png",   text           = "{{CHART}}",   match_case     = TRUE,   replace_method = "CENTER_INSIDE"  # or "CENTER_CROP" ) commit_to_slides("<presentation-id>", req)

title: Inserting images into slides
text: Like add_*_request() functions, image requests can chained committed single API call:
code: req <- add_create_slide_page_request(predefined_layout = "BLANK") req <- add_create_image_request(   req,   page_element_property = prop_full,   url = "https://example.com/background.png" ) req <- add_create_image_request(   req,   page_element_property = prop_centre,   url = "https://example.com/logo.png" ) commit_to_slides("<presentation-id>", req)

title: Authorize rgoogleslides — gs_auth
text: email Optional. specified, email can take several different forms: "jane@gmail.com", actual email address. found cache, associated token loaded. FALSE NA mean ignore cache always initiate new OAuth flow. path Path service account JSON file. scopes character vector scopes access request. cache Specifies OAuth token cache. what: rgoogleslides: R Interface to the 'Google Slides' API — rgoogleslides-package
title: rgoogleslides: R Interface to the 'Google Slides' API — rgoogleslides-package
text: Provides R interface 'Google Slides' API https://developers.google.com/slides/api. Create presentations, add slides, insert text, tables, images, videos programmatically R. Designed reproducible reporting workflows analysis results need pushed directly 'Google Slides' presentations.

title: rgoogleslides: R Interface to the 'Google Slides' API — rgoogleslides-package
text: Maintainer: Vicent Boned vicent.boned@gmail.com [contributor, copyright holder] Authors: Hairizuan Bin Noorazman hairizuanbinnoorazman@gmail.com

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.1
text: Fixed add_delete_text_request() cross-argument logic: "FIXED_RANGE" now requires start_index end_index; "FROM_START_INDEX" requires start_index; passing end_index "" now warns instead silently sending malformed request. Fixed add_insert_text_request() add_delete_text_request(): supplying one row_index / column_index now errors immediately instead silently ignoring inserting text wrong element. Fixed gs_auth_configure() error called arguments, validate directly supplied client gargle_oauth_client object. page_element_property() now validates page_object_id non-empty, non-NA string instead checking NULL. create_data_table() now errors clear message table-creation API call return object ID, rather propagating confusing downstream error. get_notes() now returns empty data frame API response include notesPage (e.g., slides retrieved without slideProperties field), instead iterating NULL silently. gs_build_url() now validates required URL placeholders (presentationId, pageObjectId) supplied constructing URL, producing clear error instead sending literal {presentationId} API. Package startup longer silently swallows errors loading built-OAuth client; rlang::warn() now emitted misconfigured environments surface problem early.

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.1
text: Added gs_shape_types() list valid shape type strings accepted Google Slides API, making easy discover available options add_create_shape_request(). add_create_video_request() gains source argument ("YOUTUBE" "DRIVE"). default remains "YOUTUBE" backward compatibility. GoogleSlidesRequest PageElementProperty R6 objects now print() methods show readable summary console.

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.1
text: add_create_shape_request() now validates shape_type full Google Slides API ShapeType enum, giving informative error pointing gs_shape_types() invalid input. add_create_slide_page_request() now validates predefined_layout API’s PredefinedLayout enum. add_delete_text_request() now validates type "", "FIXED_RANGE", "FROM_START_INDEX". add_replace_all_shapes_with_image_request() now validates replace_method "CENTER_INSIDE" "CENTER_CROP", validates page_object_ids non-empty character vector NA values. add_update_slides_position_request() now uses check_character_vector() validation add_replace_all_shapes_with_image_request(), also catches NA elements vector (previously checked type length). page_element_property() now validates width_unit, height_unit, transform_unit "PT" "EMU", validates width_magnitude height_magnitude positive numbers. Index arguments (row_index, column_index, insertion_index, start_index, end_index) across request builders now validated non-negative whole numbers. Count arguments (rows, columns, number) validated positive whole numbers. create_slides() now validates title argument string (NULL). Failed API requests now include HTTP method URL error message, making easier identify call failed complex workflows. Internal dataframe_convert() rewritten vectorised operations, avoiding previous per-cell data frame allocation loop. Internal Drive URL construction extracted shared .resolve_image_url() helper used add_create_image_request() add_replace_all_shapes_with_image_request(). .google_slide_request() .page_element_property() now use inherits() class checking. gs_deauth() now consistently returns invisible(NULL). Removed internal dead-code function check_validity() unused check_number() validator. Fixed GitHub repository URL throughout package metadata (eivicent).

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.0
text: Authentication completely rewritten use gargle package, aligning tidyverse Google ecosystem (googledrive, googlesheets4). authorize() deprecated favour gs_auth() (#new). assertthat dependency replaced cli user-facing error messages richer formatting context.

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.0
text: Fixed translate_X typo page_element_property silently broke element positioning translate coordinates set. Fixed cellLocation placement add_insert_table_rows_request(), add_insert_table_columns_request(), add_delete_table_row_request(), add_delete_table_column_request() – cell location incorrectly placed top level instead inside operation object. Fixed duplicate objectId add_create_slide_page_request() placed ID inside createSlide top level. Fixed slideObjectIds wrapping add_update_slides_position_request() wrapped vector extra list layer. Fixed wrong package name examples (library(googleslides) -> library(rgoogleslides)).

title: rgoogleslides 1.0.0
text: HTTP requests now use gargle’s request_retry() automatic rate limiting retry logic. Improved performance get_tables(), get_text_boxes(), get_notes() replacing grow--rbind pattern list accumulation. exported functions now @return documentation guarded examples per current CRAN requirements. Added testthat 3 test suite unit tests request builders, page element properties, utility functions. Added GitHub Actions CI R CMD check across platforms.
